th 15/Dated: 12 August, 2024
1.

In pursuance of order dated 22.07.2024 Mr. Sunil Chandra, District Land Acquisition Officer,
Ranchi is present before this Court.
2. In compliance of order dated 22.07.2024, a supplementary counter affidavit has been filed.

Relevant paragraph Nos.16 and 17 of the supplementary counter affidavit are quoted hereinbelow:
"16.

That it is stated that on receipt of the requisition for acquisition of land khata no.
65, plot no. 1001, village-Namkum, the respondent no. 4 initiated L.A. Case No.
11/2024- 2025.
17.

That it is stated that the respondent No.4 will consume a minimum period of 100 days for preparation of the award after complying with the various provisions of The Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and other allied Acts, from the date of issuance of preliminary notification under section -11 of the Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013."

sentences.text: Thus, the utilization of the land is not in dispute.
But it has been submitted that by mistake the land in question has not been acquired.

Now a new acquisition proceeding has been initiated being L.A. Case No.11 of 2024-25 and it has been promised before this Court that that the required payment will be made by preparing the Award within 100 days from today.

4. In that view of the matter, put up this case on 25.11.2024.
5.

Personal appearance of Mr. Sunil Chandra, District Land Acquisition Officer, Ranchi is, hereby,
dispensed with.
